title: Instruction execution can be modeled as state transition
proposition: A useful execution model represents machine state explicitly and describes each instruction by its effect on that state.
scope: A pedagogical abstract-machine model for tracing; not a cycle-accurate physical CPU model.
exceptions: Optimized hardware may execute internally in ways that differ from the architectural sequence while preserving specified behavior.
score_rationale: An academic curriculum source and an independent formal specification agree on state-based execution models.
